data: All entities, identifiers, records, credentials and verification outcomes are synthetic.
chrome_status: Chrome was authorized but unavailable in the available browser inventory; preview checks used the in-app browser.
workflows_observed: Patient sign-in using password and current local TOTP, masked CNIC and own diagnostic history.
Physician directory distinguishes professional registration and hospital affiliation.
Appointment booking alone leaves physician with no patient reports.
Patient explicitly selects an exact report version and time interval; no report checkbox is preselected.
Physician sees only the explicitly authorized version and its provenance.
Lab submitter sees assigned source work; a mismatched specimen produces a held submission.
Distinct lab approver sees the held submission without an approval action.
Hospital manages profiles/affiliation separately from registration, without clinical navigation.
Patient withdraws the grant; revoked state persists.
After final server restart, the existing patient session and diagnostic history load successfully.
live_demo_state: Synthetic browser actions and their audit history are retained; data is not silently reset.
limits: Implementation preview only. Not a formal benchmark, independent security audit, or direct stakeholder validation.
